header.running_head: The Hijrah of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Jahash (RA)

blocks.arabic_text: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
blocks.text: From mankind is he who would sell himself seeking Allaah's pleasure and Allaah is Most Compassionate towards His bondsmen.
When Rasulullaah ﷺ saw Hadhrat Suhayb (RA), he said, "Your transaction has been profitable, O Abu Yahya!" Rasulullaah ﷺ then recited the above verse to him. [^2]

Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) narrates that when he decided to migrate from Makkah to Rasulullaah ﷺ, the Quraysh said to him, "O Suhayb! When you came to us, you had no wealth. You are now leaving as a wealthy man. By Allaah! We can never allow this!" Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) proposed to them, "Will you let me go if I give you all my wealth?" When they agreed, he gave his wealth to them and they let him go. By the time Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) reached Madinah, Rasulullaah ﷺ was already aware of the incident and said, "You've earned a grand profit, O Suhayb! You've earned a grand profit, O Suhayb!" [^3]
The Hijrah of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Zaid narrates that whenever Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) passed by his house (in Makkah) from which he migrated, he would close his eyes and would not even look at it or stop there. [^4] Another narration[^5] states that whenever Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) spoke about Rasulullaah ﷺ, he would cry and whenever he passed his house (in Makkah), he would close his eyes.
The Hijrah of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Jahash (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Jahash (RA) (actually his brother Abd bin Jahash (RA), as it will become clear from the next Hadith) was the last person to migrate to Madinah and had become blind. When he resolved to migrate, his wife who was the daughter of Abu Sufyaan bin Harb bin Umayyah disliked it. She advised him to rather migrate to someone else other than Rasulullaah ﷺ. (Disregarding her advice) He took his family and wealth and secretly left the Quraysh and came to Rasulullaah ﷺ in Madinah. (His brother-in-law) Abu Sufyaan (became very angry and)
